name: threat-modeling
description: Systematic threat modeling using STRIDE (default) or PASTA methodology. Decomposes system, identifies trust boundaries, enumerates threats per element (spoofing / tampering / repudiation / information disclosure / denial of service / elevation of privilege), assesses likelihood + impact, maps to mitigations. Produces threat-inventory with controls, residual risk, and prioritized action plan. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
